messages:
marin (design): Saw a stack of mobile issues during usability sessions: horizontal scroll on the Runs table, sidebar toggle overlaps action buttons, and breadcrumbs disappear behind the drawer. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/ux-mobile :grimacing:

oliver (frontend): can repro on Pixel 4a and iPhone 8. The table is very dense; .cell--actions has a min-width which forces overflow.

sara (product): mobile triage is a real pain for support; users expect a tap-to-open experience. We should decide: responsive stacked rows vs switching to a card/list view on <=420px.

marin (design): I sketched two approaches in Figma: A) stacked rows: keep table semantics but wrap each row into label/value lines, B) card list: convert rows into touch-friendly cards with primary metadata up top and actions beneath. Card option gives better spacing but is a bigger DOM change.

joni (eng): virtualization concern: we use react-window for the table. Card list works if we keep a virtualized list, but cards are taller so perf differs. Stacked rows have smaller delta in DOM change if we keep same row element.

aria-a11y-bot: a11y flags: whichever we pick, ensure reading order matches visual order. If switching to cards, use role="list" and role="listitem" and ensure keyboard navigation is preserved. For bottom sheet drawer, use aria-modal="true" and focus trap; restore focus to triggering control.

oliver (frontend): technical tradeoffs: stacked rows can be CSS-only at breakpoint (grid -> flex-column) and keep same DOM node so react-window needs minimal work. Cards will need a renderer change and more CSS, but prettier.

pat (qa): QA note: also check landscape small phones and split-screen Android. If we make a bottom sheet for details, it must not introduce double scroll bars. Test touch target sizes (>=44px) for primary actions.

sara (product): copy nit: card/header should show run id + human time, and secondary line for model short name. Drawer header should be "Run details — <short-id>" not the full model name to avoid wrapping. Full model name can be shown on a second line truncated with long-press to reveal.

joni (eng): implementation proposal: 1) immediate fix: at max-width: 480px force .cell--actions to collapse into a kebab and remove min-width to prevent horizontal scroll. 2) medium: stacked rows CSS at <=420px to improve scanning. 3) long-term: optional card view behind ff_mobile_card_list. Keep feature flag for rollout.

martin (design): typo: I'm marin not martin ;)
